milestones.name: Below the Gloaming
milestones.line: The last of the light is above you now.

milestones.name: The Roofs of the Drowned City
milestones.line: You have touched the floor. It was not the floor.

fast: It answers before the question has finished rising.
slow: It waits, and the water waits with it.
rare: It speaks the words the deep keeps for itself.
common: It says what everyone says, and the sea forgives it.
night: It comes down after midnight, when the lamps are low.
day: It dives by daylight, as if that helps.
streak: Its lantern has burned for {streak} days.
drifting: It has been away. The sea noticed.
newcomer: It is new here. The deep is patient.
warded: Something kept its lantern lit while it slept.

ward.name: Ward
ward.blurb: Keeps your lantern lit through one missed day.

bestiary.name: Barreleye
bestiary.line: It looked up at us through its own head.
bestiary.fact: Its eyes sit inside a clear, fluid-filled dome and turn to look straight up.
